Creates a normal or inline Nunjucks-compatible template link for the authenticated organization. Template links require Pro+, a 307 redirect, and are rendered from safe request context. Respects monthly tier limits and optionally accepts a custom short code, UTM parameters, tags, expiry, and device destinations
